label: Median 2-bedroom annual rent (AED)
provenance: Third-party site republishing Ejari rental contracts. Not an official DLD feed. This breakdown is Dubai-wide only: the API ignores its own area filter on bedroom-level statistics (verified: filtering by area returns an empty bedroomStats array), so this cannot be shown per community.
period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-08-28 (the API holds current-year data only)
method: Median Ejari annual rent across all 2-bedroom rental contracts, all property types, Dubai-wide.
